newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Soy and corn remain steady.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Soy and corn remain steady.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf soy, corn and wheat basis values remained mostly steady on Wednesday amid lackluster dealings and a lack of export activity.
In export news, Taiwan's FGEP corn procurement group bought one 54,000 tonne shipment of U.S. corn at tender on Wednesday from Zennoh for April/May shipment, traders said.
The Korea Feedgrain Purchase Committee bought 52,000 tonnes of corn on Tuesday at $136.95 per tonne, C&F, traders said on Wednesday. Arrival was set for June 30 to the western port of Inchon.
Taiwan's Breakfast Soybean Procurement Association's Kaohsiung division bought one 54,000 tonne shipment of U.S. soybeans at a retender on Wednesday from Cargill for March/April, traders said.
